Definition: Golan, a place east of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Golan is a town in Bashan, east of the Jordan, given to the tribe of Manasseh as a city of refuge. A manslayer who fled there could live, safe from the avenger, until his case was heard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Golan matters because God's story happened in real places, and Golan is one of them.
